recognize_zh: 視野右上方有一個形態正常、多葉核的大型巨核細胞，其餘有核細胞多為各階段顆粒球系與嗜伊紅球；箭頭指的是一顆小型、細胞質深藍、圓核的早期紅血球前驅細胞（嗜鹼性正母紅血球），整片幾乎找不到成熟母紅血球；巨核細胞與顆粒球系保留、只有紅血球系缺乏，符合 Diamond-Blackfan anemia。
features: Marked myeloid predominance with granulocytic precursors at all stages and several eosinophils
Arrow: rare early erythroid precursor with round nucleus and deeply basophilic cytoplasm (basophilic normoblast)
Large megakaryocyte with abundant granular cytoplasm and normally lobulated nucleus
Near absence of polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts
Scattered small lymphocytes; no dysplasia or blast increase; brownish red cell staining artifact
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with a marked myeloid predominance, including granulocytic precursors at all stages of maturation and several eosinophils. A large megakaryocyte with abundant granular cytoplasm and a normally lobulated nucleus is present, indicating preserved megakaryopoiesis. Erythroid precursors are markedly reduced; a rare early erythroid precursor with a round nucleus and deeply basophilic cytoplasm is identified (arrow), with virtually no later-stage normoblasts. Findings are consistent with selective erythroid hypoplasia with preserved granulopoiesis and megakaryopoiesis, supporting Diamond-Blackfan anemia in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: Same selective erythroid hypoplasia, but occurs in older children without congenital anomalies, with normal MCV, HbF, and eADA, and resolves spontaneously.
Residual pronormoblasts are giant with intranuclear viral inclusions, and B19 PCR is positive.

ddx.dx: Aplastic anemia or inherited bone marrow failure
ddx.vs: Involves all three lineages with hypocellularity and reduced megakaryocytes, whereas megakaryocytes and granulocytes are preserved here.
Features vacuolization of erythroid and myeloid precursors, ring sideroblasts, and exocrine pancreatic insufficiency with mitochondrial DNA deletion.
